name: Woodcarver's Tools
operation_language: Authoring intent only; not registered engine syntax.

rules.text: Ability: dexterity. Utilize: Carve a pattern in wood (DC 10). Craft: Club, Greatclub, Quarterstaff, Ranged weapons except Pistol, Musket and Sling; Arcane Focus, Arrows, Bolts, Druidic Focus, Ink Pen, Needles. Tool proficiency adds PB to ability checks using the tool; if also proficient in a skill used with the check, gain Advantage. Each Artisan tool needs its own proficiency.
